clue.text: Snooty-sounding lifestyle familiar to gardeners?

indicators.note: the hyphenated 'sounding' attached to the first word says only that word is taken by how it is said

parts.note: snooty means haughty, superior
a culture is a people's way of life

explanation.surface: A posh, stuck-up way of living that gardeners supposedly know well.
explanation.walkthrough: The indicator 'sounding' is fused to 'Snooty' by a hyphen, so only that word is heard; 'lifestyle' is taken at face value.
explanation.definitionFit: The cultivation of gardens is the subject every gardener knows, so the craft is what is familiar to them.

clue.text: One who arranges entertainments at first in new garrison

indicators.note: the first letter of entertainments is placed in the rearranged garrison letters
new signals the letters of garrison are made into a new arrangement
at first takes only the opening letter of entertainments

explanation.surface: Someone who puts on shows for the troops, starting in a newly set-up garrison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One who arranges entertainments' reads as the definition, but 'entertainments at first' gives only E, put 'in' the anagram ('new') of GARRISON.
explanation.definitionFit: A planner or coordinator is one who arranges things.

clue.text: Rent trouble provoking storm

parts.note: rent, past participle of rend, means torn
ado is fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: A dispute about rent stirs up a furious row between landlord and tenant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rent' looks like a payment but is the past participle of 'rend'.
explanation.definitionFit: A twister is a violent rotating storm.

clue.text: Frequently vary what one may get on paying the butcher

definitions.meaning: to keep altering one's mind or plans

definitions.text: what one may get on paying the butcher
definitions.meaning: a cut of meat and the coins handed back from the payment

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the phrase literally: a pork CHOP AND your CHANGE.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to keep switching one's plans or opinions, and literally names a meat cut plus money returned.

clue.text: Misuse of rifle may have got him where he is!

definitions.text: Misuse of rifle may have got him where he is!

indicators.note: misuse of the letters of rifle means they are put to a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Shooting someone with a gun is what landed this prisoner in jail for good.
explanation.definitionFit: A prisoner serving a life sentence might well be there for killing someone with a gun.

clue.text: Reportedly bring in large vessel

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the word for bring in is taken as heard, not as spelt

parts.note: to bring in money is to earn it

explanation.surface: Supposedly a large ship is bringing in cargo.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea or burial vessel of some size; the word names a big container.

clue.text: They all go out on the stage

definitions.text: They all go out on the stage

parts.words: They all go out on the stage
parts.note: the Latin stage direction meaning 'they leave', telling the actors to depart

explanation.surface: A description of everyone leaving a theatre stage together.
explanation.definitionFit: Script directions in Latin tell several actors to depart, so it literally means they go out.

clue.text: One writing on church for little cash

parts.note: a pen is the thing that does the writing
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A writer produces something about the church in return for a pittance.
explanation.definitionFit: Small coins are a modest sum of money, the smallest units in British currency.

clue.text: Mountain peak one visits for example with hesitation

indicators.note: the letter for one visits, so goes inside, the other letters

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A climber approaches a summit hesitantly, perhaps one at a time.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous Swiss Alpine summit, known for its north face.

clue.text: Crime of receiver of stolen goods

parts.note: a fence handles stolen property

explanation.surface: Naming the crime committed by a person handling stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A breach of the law is a misdemeanour or wrongdoing, a synonym.

clue.text: Work sung in prison, followed by cheers?

indicators.note: followed by puts the word for cheers after the word for prison

parts.note: the can is slang for prison
ta-ta and cheers are both informal British goodbyes

explanation.surface: Inmates sing a piece in jail and are applauded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cheers' is the British farewell, TATA, not applause.
explanation.definitionFit: A choral composition with voices, in the manner of Bach, is a musical work for singing.

clue.text: Horse going round back of yew tree

indicators.note: going round says the horse word encircles the other letter

parts.note: a roan is a horse with a mixed coat

indicators.note: back of takes the last letter of yew

explanation.surface: A horse circles behind a yew and ends up beside another tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The mountain ash is a small tree with red berries.

clue.text: Orchestral instruments and how they're played, buffeted by the elements?

parts.note: the wind is the section of woodwind and brass
wind instruments are blown

explanation.surface: Woodwind players describe their instruments while out in a gale.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair or trees tousled by gusts have been tossed about by weather.

clue.text: Toledo employer's promise to board ship alongside island

indicators.note: to board a ship is to go inside it, so the promise sits inside

parts.note: SS is steamship
giving your word is a promise
the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A Spanish city's employer swears to go aboard a vessel moored by an island.
explanation.walkthrough: Toledo was famous for its blades, so a 'Toledo' is a sword.
explanation.definitionFit: Fine Spanish blades were called Toledos, and a fencer or duellist wields one.

clue.text: Girl holding slightly leftist views?

parts.note: mild means only to a slight degree
red stands for communist or left-wing politics

explanation.surface: A young woman with moderately left-wing opinions.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional English female first name.

clue.text: Quickly seize a short piece of music

definitions.meaning: a fragment or brief ... of a tune

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means grab hastily; the noun is a brief fragment of song heard in passing.

clue.text: Condition of artwork university abandoned

indicators.note: abandoned means the university letter is dropped from the artwork

parts.note: a statue is a sculpted artwork

explanation.surface: A neglected sculpture left behind when the college moved out.
explanation.definitionFit: One's condition is one's situation or circumstances, a synonym.

clue.text: Woman not quite conforming to standard?

indicators.note: not quite means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: normal means conforming to the standard

explanation.surface: A woman who doesn't entirely fit the norm.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, as in Bellini's opera heroine.

clue.text: Something useful a Hardy heroine brought up

indicators.note: in a down clue brought up means the heroine's name is written upwards

parts.note: Tess of the d'Urbervilles, Thomas Hardy's heroine

explanation.surface: A useful item that a Hardy heroine raised.
explanation.definitionFit: Something valuable or beneficial is an advantage or resource.

clue.text: Fish a politician accommodated in shed

indicators.note: accommodated in means placed inside the shed

parts.note: a hut is a shed
Lib is a Liberal

explanation.surface: A fish and a politician are housed in a garden shed.
explanation.definitionFit: A large flatfish of northern seas.

clue.text: Traitor's initial justification for betrayal of sovereign

indicators.note: initial takes the first letter of the traitor's

parts.note: a reason is a justification

explanation.surface: A traitor's first excuse for turning against the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: High crime against the state or crown is disloyalty to one's ruler.

clue.text: Film a character in Athens

parts.note: E.T. is Spielberg's film

explanation.surface: A film with a character in Athens.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek letter, the seventh of the alphabet, is a character used in Athens.

clue.text: Marsupial's time to settle for the night

parts.note: roo is a kangaroo, roo's its possessive
T is time

explanation.surface: A kangaroo's bedtime arrives.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds perch to sleep; the verb means bed down for the night.

clue.text: General direction in trial causing great distress

indicators.note: in places the general direction inside the trial

parts.note: a court hearing is a trial
a trend is a general direction

explanation.surface: A general giving orders during a court case causes anguish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'General' looks like a military officer but describes 'direction'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something agonising tears at the emotions, so it brings severe anguish.
